name: The Secret of My Assistant
original_name: のポンコツ秘書は彼か彼女か？
overview: To stop family bankruptcy, Shinzo Rika cross-dresses as "Shinzo Riku" and gets an assistant job at a top-tier apparel company. He faces bullying of cold, good-looking CEO, Midowuji Kazya. Rika strikes back, and in time, their arguments turn into a fun banter. While Kazya avoids his attraction for "Riku", his life takes an unexpected turn. Will Rica be able to catch both his love and dreams?
